page.layout: One block: title page, all lines centred in one column; a printer's device (oval woodcut with a stork/crane and the words EPI SCOP) below the text; imprint line below the device. Handwritten shelfmark top left is not printed text.

main_text.l: NVNC primum in lucem prolati, & latinam in

page.notes: The imprint reads "BBASILEAE, ANNO LXXXI" in the scan; the last numeral appears as LXXXI, rendered here as printed in the copy. The woodcut device shows a stork on a staff with the legend "EPI SCOP" and is not transcribed as text. Handwritten marks ("Auct. G.") at top left are not printed and are omitted. Some letters in the top lines are partly damaged, and "T'HEODO-" shows a stray mark before the H that is probably a printing ornament. Where the scan is unclear, readings follow the most likely print.
